campaigns.name: Hook or Bust
campaigns.objective: signups — drive new users to try podclip by emphasizing its superior clip selection.
campaigns.big_idea: Position podclip as the only auto-clipping tool that reliably finds the most shareable moments, thanks to its model trained on 40,000 real human-rated clips. Contrast with generic tools that just chop up audio blindly.
campaigns.hook: Your podcast's best 40 seconds? We'll find it. Not 60 random seconds — the actual hook.

sample_copy.headline: Stop clipping blindly.
sample_copy.body: podclip finds the moment people actually want to share — not just any 60 seconds. Trained on 40,000 real clips rated by creators, so it gets what works.
sample_copy.cta: Try the smart clipper for free

assets_needed: short demo video showing clip selection vs. competitor
campaigns.why_on_brand: Uses punchy, creator-savvy language and focuses on real outcomes, aligning with the voice and avoid list in the brand DNA.

campaigns.name: Clip & Share Sprint
campaigns.objective: retention — encourage weekly clip creation and sharing among active users.
campaigns.big_idea: Launch a 7-day challenge where users process one episode and share their best clip, with tips and templates provided. Celebrate the most engaging clips.
campaigns.hook: Your best clip in 7 days — we'll help you make and share it.

sample_copy.headline: The 7-Day Clip Challenge
sample_copy.body: We'll help you turn one episode into a killer clip and get it out the door. Daily tips, presets, and support — all built for busy podcasters.

campaigns.success_metric: percentage of active users who export a clip during the week
campaigns.why_on_brand: Talks directly to time-constrained creators with actionable support, matching the audience language and dos in the brand DNA.

campaigns.name: From Episode to Viral
campaigns.objective: awareness — showcase real clips made with podclip to demonstrate quality and virality potential.
campaigns.big_idea: Curate and promote the most engaging clips created by users, highlighting how podclip helped them go viral or grow their audience.
campaigns.hook: This clip got 50K views. It wasn't hand-cut — it was podclip.

sample_copy.headline: How this clip went viral
sample_copy.body: No editor. No hours of scrubbing. Just podclip finding the moment that hooked 50K viewers. See how it works — and how you can do it too.

campaigns.why_on_brand: Uses energetic, outcome-focused messaging and real creator examples, staying true to the brand's voice and proof points.

campaigns.name: Agency Mode Ready
campaigns.objective: community — attract small production agencies by showing how podclip scales their output.
campaigns.big_idea: Highlight how agencies use podclip to manage multiple shows efficiently, with consistent branding and fast turnaround.
campaigns.hook: One tool. Ten shows. Zero extra editors.

sample_copy.headline: Agency-ready clipping, finally
sample_copy.body: Manage multiple podcasts with per-show styles, fast renders, and no manual work. Scale your output without hiring another editor.

campaigns.why_on_brand: Focuses on efficiency and scalability without jargon, speaking directly to professional creators as intended in the brand DNA.

confidence.notes: Campaigns are grounded in APP_PROFILE differentiators and BRAND_DNA voice. No external data was needed. Effort estimates reflect solo builder constraints.
